newsitem.title: HONG KONG: N.Korean defectors aim to get to Hong Kong - paper.
newsitem.headline: N.Korean defectors aim to get to Hong Kong - paper.

text.p: A group of North Korean defectors is waiting in the southern Chinese city of Shenzhen for the opportunity to slip across the border in Hong Kong, the South China Morning Post said on Wednesday.
The daily quoted diplomatic sources as saying the defectors had fled Stalinist North Korea into China and made their way south to the Hong Kong border.
They hoped to get into Hong Kong before the British colony is handed back to China at midnight on June 30 and the "freedom road" closes, the paper said.
It said diplomats believed the South Korean embassy in Beijing would become the new centre for defectors seeking asylum.
The Hong Kong government declined to comment on the report.
A Shenzhen municipal official said by telephone he had no knowledge of any North Koreans massing in the city.
